Agent Name: Grocery_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The agent concluded that no supermarkets are within 2 blocks by using an inappropriate methodology: they treated “Lincoln Park” as a single point (2045 N Lincoln Park W) instead of checking proximity to the park’s nearest boundary and used a rough, incorrect blocks-per-mile conversion. This led them to misclassify nearby stores like Big Apple Finer Foods as 4 blocks away when they are likely within two blocks of the park’s edge, resulting in an incorrect final conclusion.
